name: studyshare
description: StudyShare : plateforme de partage de fiches de révision entre étudiants
author: Laurent Dupuis

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run start -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm test -w server && npm test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:shared && npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
